source.kept: the floor mask by the parser's floor rule and its wall segments with the height span of the triangles that give them; its '#' cells are not kept (cells a wall crosses: the bot stands on them)

grid.encoding: floor: zlib+base64 of numpy.packbits over rows x cols bits, row-major, row 0 the smallest z, column 0 the smallest x, 1 = floor

walls_encoding: [x0, z0, x1, z1, y low, y high, flag] mm; flag 0 solid (the Havok mesh has no invisible-blocker flag), 2 walked through: the bot's own live steps crossed it
